- City 1 receives 19 from city 3, which meets its demand of 19.

- City 2 ships out 19+4 = 23, matching its supply.
- City 3 ships out 18+19 = 37, matching its supply.

- 4·6 = 24 (2→6)

- 3→1 at 7 is the cheapest way to reach city 1.
